cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Be Right in Retrospect
cards.instruction: Perform certainty by reinterpreting every surprise as something your earlier words were obviously predicting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. My forecast said sunny. Clearly I meant your reaction to the refund.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The holiday was ruined by rain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Which created the refund and your brightened outlook.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A symbol of optimism. You must read the whole prediction generously.

mechanism: A coaches its former travel-planning pupil to reinterpret a sunny forecast and sunscreen instruction as a correct prediction of refund joy.
confusable: Not announcing a new hopeful outcome: A insists each contradictory earlier phrase already foresaw this result.
comparison: Flood wordplay versus refund optimism claimed as weather foresight.
